author: Smoebo
generator: Grok Build command-line tool 1.0.60, image_gen, one call per plate with the prompt recorded here unchanged
subjectBasis: Original designs for entries of the mystery and horror bestiaries (src/lib/bestiary/mystery.json, horror.json), per docs/art/creature-art-guidance.md. An entry the card presents as a person is painted as that person, so the plate shows no more than the card: The Good Doctor is a country doctor, The Night Clerk a clerk. No published illustration, film character or real person was named or supplied as an input.
encoding: Each 1024x1024 JPEG original resized once to 256x256 (cover) and encoded once to WebP quality 75 with sharp.
review: Each shipped plate was viewed at full size and in a round crop at 96px and 40px on dark and light surrounds. The Wrong Door and The Old Family are second paintings: the first door came back inside a painted round frame, and the first family showed three faces too small to read at 40px.
